background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit below the bank's: A+ from Fitch, BBB+ from S&P on a positive outlook and A1 from Moody's after its upgrade on 12 Jul 2021. Consolidated capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.8% is at the peer median, and both have fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025 as capital is returned. LCR of 119% is above the median. The flagged news on 10 Sep 2026 is a trading outage tied to a processing vendor, resolved and operational rather than financial. Thin consolidated capital for a bank of this grade.
